panels.title: Receita em Risco
panels.description: Valor de churners que o modelo não detectou — quanto estamos deixando escapar (FN × custo por churner)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((fn * false_negative_cost)::numeric, 2) AS value FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Valor Protegido pelo Modelo
panels.description: Estimativa de receita salva ao identificar churners antes que saiam (TP × custo por churner)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((tp * false_negative_cost)::numeric, 2) AS value FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Saldo Operacional
panels.description: Valor protegido menos custo de retenções desnecessárias — benefício líquido do modelo

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(((tp * false_negative_cost) - (fp * false_positive_cost))::numeric, 2) AS value FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Taxa de Captura de Churners
panels.description: % de clientes que realmente churnariam e foram identificados — quanto o modelo não deixa passar

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((tp::float / NULLIF(tp + fn, 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS value FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Eficiência de Retenção
panels.description: % das ações de retenção disparadas que eram realmente necessárias — evita desperdício orçamentário

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((tp::float / NULLIF(tp + fp, 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS value FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Clientes em Risco Alto
panels.description: Clientes com probabilidade de churn acima de 70% — pipeline de risco imediato para ação comercial

targets.rawSql: SELECT high_risk_count AS value FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Evolução do Impacto Financeiro — Champion
panels.description: Tendência histórica: quanto o modelo está protegendo vs. quanto está escapando a cada evaluation run

targets.rawSql: SELECT evaluated_at AS time, 'Valor Protegido' AS metric, ROUND((tp * false_negative_cost)::numeric, 2) AS value FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY 1

SELECT evaluated_at AS time, 'Receita em Risco' AS metric, ROUND((fn * false_negative_cost)::numeric, 2) AS value FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Perfil de Risco da Base de Clientes
panels.description: Distribuição estratégica dos clientes por nível de propensão ao churn — último evaluation run

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Alto Risco (>70%)' AS segmento, SUM(high_risk_count) AS total FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') AND evaluated_at = (SELECT MAX(evaluated_at) FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')) UNION ALL SELECT 'Risco Médio (30–70%)', SUM(medium_risk_count) FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') AND evaluated_at = (SELECT MAX(evaluated_at) FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')) UNION ALL SELECT 'Baixo Risco (<30%)', SUM(low_risk_count) FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') AND evaluated_at = (SELECT MAX(evaluated_at) FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}'))

panels.title: Exposição Financeira vs Ineficiência Operacional — Último Run
panels.description: Comparativo por modelo: quanto estamos expondo em receita perdida (FN) vs. quanto desperdiçamos em retenções inúteis (FP) | Atenção: contagens brutas (FP/FN) refletem o volume de tráfego recebido por cada modelo. Champion recebe 100% do tráfego; challenger recebe apenas a fração configurada (ex: 20%). Use as métricas por predição (cost_per_prediction) para comparações normalizadas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_name_snapshot, ROUND((fp * false_positive_cost)::numeric, 2) AS custo_ineficiencia, ROUND((fn * false_negative_cost)::numeric, 2) AS exposicao_financeira FROM churn.model_performance WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') AND evaluated_at = (SELECT MAX(evaluated_at) FROM churn.model_performance WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')) ORDER BY model_name_snapshot

panels.title: Custo por Churner Evitado
panels.description: Custo operacional total por churner identificado — quanto investimos para salvar cada cliente

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((total_cost::float / NULLIF(tp, 0))::numeric, 2) AS value FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Cobertura da Base em Alerta
panels.description: % da base de clientes que está sob monitoramento ativo de churn — equilíbrio entre cobertura e precisão

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(((tp + fp)::float / NULLIF(total_predictions, 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS value FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Comparativo Champion vs Challenger — Último Run
panels.description: Modelos challenger com potencial de redução de custo ou melhora na taxa de captura

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_name_snapshot AS challenger, ROUND(delta_cost_per_pred::numeric, 4) AS delta_custo, ROUND(delta_cost_per_pred_pct::numeric, 1) AS delta_custo_pct, ROUND(delta_recall::numeric, 4) AS delta_captura FROM churn.evaluation_comparison WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') AND evaluation_run_id = (SELECT evaluation_run_id FROM churn.evaluation_run_results WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AND model_role_snapshot <> 'champion' ORDER BY delta_cost_per_pred ASC

panels.title: Threshold vs Custo Total
panels.description: Custo operacional total a cada nível de threshold — identifica o ponto ótimo de menor custo. Calculado sobre predições com outcomes registrados.

targets.rawSql: WITH thresholds AS (SELECT generate_series(5, 90, 5) / 100.0 AS thr), costs AS (SELECT false_positive_cost AS fp_cost, false_negative_cost AS fn_cost FROM churn.model_performance WHERE model_role_snapshot = 'champion' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}') ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 1), preds AS (SELECT p.churn_prob::numeric AS prob, o.churned FROM churn.outcomes o JOIN churn.predictions p ON p.id = o.prediction_id WHERE p.churn_prob IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')), sweep AS (SELECT ROUND(t.thr::numeric, 2) AS thr, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prob >= t.thr AND NOT p.churned) AS fp, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prob < t.thr AND p.churned) AS fn FROM thresholds t CROSS JOIN preds p GROUP BY t.thr) SELECT s.thr::text AS threshold, ROUND((s.fp * c.fp_cost + s.fn * c.fn_cost)::numeric, 0) AS custo_total FROM sweep s, costs c ORDER BY s.thr

panels.title: Threshold vs Falsos Negativos
panels.description: Churners não detectados a cada nível de threshold — quanto maior o threshold, mais churners passam despercebidos e viram receita perdida.

targets.rawSql: WITH thresholds AS (SELECT generate_series(5, 90, 5) / 100.0 AS thr), preds AS (SELECT p.churn_prob::numeric AS prob, o.churned FROM churn.outcomes o JOIN churn.predictions p ON p.id = o.prediction_id WHERE p.churn_prob IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')), sweep AS (SELECT ROUND(t.thr::numeric, 2) AS thr, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prob < t.thr AND p.churned) AS fn FROM thresholds t CROSS JOIN preds p GROUP BY t.thr) SELECT s.thr::text AS threshold, s.fn AS churners_perdidos FROM sweep s ORDER BY s.thr

panels.title: Threshold vs Recall
panels.description: Taxa de captura de churners a cada nível de threshold — onde o modelo captura mais, mas a que custo operacional?

targets.rawSql: WITH thresholds AS (SELECT generate_series(5, 90, 5) / 100.0 AS thr), preds AS (SELECT p.churn_prob::numeric AS prob, o.churned FROM churn.outcomes o JOIN churn.predictions p ON p.id = o.prediction_id WHERE p.churn_prob IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM churn.tenants WHERE slug = '${tenant}')), sweep AS (SELECT ROUND(t.thr::numeric, 2) AS thr, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prob >= t.thr AND p.churned) AS tp, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prob < t.thr AND p.churned) AS fn FROM thresholds t CROSS JOIN preds p GROUP BY t.thr) SELECT s.thr::text AS threshold, ROUND((s.tp::float / NULLIF(s.tp + s.fn, 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS recall_pct FROM sweep s ORDER BY s.thr
